items.title: Reconcile Stable/S+/S-/O+ Definitions for V182o Re-Audit
items.description: The live jnwb.addressing is_stable proxy (quality>=1.0, stable_plus aliased identically) is a much weaker test than the project's canonical 3-criterion stability pipeline (tag_stable_units.py: >=5 spikes/trial in every correct trial + firing_rate>=1Hz + (presence_ratio>=0.98 OR snr>0.75)), and the earlier V182o O+ candidate audit (examples/06_find_omission_positive_units_v182o.py) used an ad hoc Mann-Whitney+4Hz-diff test instead of the project's real candidate-labeling pipeline (run_spk_response_metrics_a8_1.py: paired Wilcoxon vs local pre-omission baseline + unpaired Mann-Whitney vs matched control, Cohen's d>0.3, BH-FDR q<0.05, S_plus/S_minus/O_plus_candidate/X_candidate priority resolution). Re-run both the canonical stability test and the canonical S+/S-/O+/X candidate pipeline on sub-V182o_ses-260629 so results are comparable to the historical grand_database_6040_units.csv methodology, and reconcile which of the previously-flagged 4 units survive under the correct definitions.

items.title: Brainstorm 2026-07-10: Exploratory vs confirmatory stats API split
items.description: External audit root cause: convenience APIs blur exploratory dual-testing with publication inference. Permanent fix: exploratory_* returns dual tests without FDR theatre; confirmatory_* requires hypothesis family + correction axis + CI; diagnostics gate before GC/decoding claims.
items.planning_note: Too architectural for a single-file score; folded into jnwb/statistics.py tbi as API split direction. Promote to proposed after FDR fix lands.

concrete_plan.goal: Split StatisticalAnalysis into two clearly-named namespaces: exploratory_* (dual parametric+nonparametric, no FDR theatre, for pilot analysis) and confirmatory_* (requires explicit hypothesis + alpha, outputs BH-adjusted q-values). Prevents users from treating exploratory dual-test results as publication-ready p-values.
steps: 1. Add exploratory_compare(x, y) -> dual_result (no FDR keys, no q-values)
2. Add confirmatory_compare(x, y, alpha=0.05, hypothesis=str) -> confirmed_result with BH q-value
3. Deprecate fdr_pval_* aliases in compare_groups output with clear migration message
4. Update all notebook/script callers to use appropriate namespace
5. Add test: exploratory_compare must not have q_value key; confirmatory_compare must
6. Reframe AGENTS.md footgun #22 (duplicate stats) to reference the split
concrete_plan.falsifier: Test suite includes: test_exploratory_compare_no_q_value() and test_confirmatory_compare_has_q_value() both pass; all existing callers updated; no fdr_pval_* keys in new API output
